text: 今日，上海链家披露，自9月14号上线至今三周，全新服务”诚意卖”成交突破100单。成交房源中，近四分之一此前挂牌超过90天，平均挂牌天数达63天；而通过”诚意卖”成交后，平均成交周期缩短至8天左右。（中国房地产报）
text_en: Today, Shanghai Lianjia disclosed that since its launch on September 14, the new service "Sincere Sale" has closed more than 100 transactions in three weeks. Among the transacted properties, nearly one-quarter had previously been listed for more than 90 days, with an average listing period of 63 days; after being sold through "Sincere Sale," the average transaction cycle was shortened to about 8 days. (China Real Estate News)
